description: This file manages ARM Cortex-M interrupt handling, including enabling/disabling IRQs, setting priorities, handling spurious interrupts, and supporting dynamic ISR connection and secure/non-secure configurations.

methods.name: arch_irq_enable
methods.description: Enables the specified IRQ using NVIC.

methods.name: arch_irq_disable
methods.description: Disables the specified IRQ using NVIC.

methods.name: arch_irq_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if the specified IRQ is enabled.

methods.name: z_arm_irq_priority_set
methods.description: Sets the priority for a given IRQ.

methods.name: z_irq_spurious
methods.description: Handles spurious interrupts by triggering a fatal error.

methods.name: z_arm_fatal_error
methods.description: Handles fatal errors related to ARM architecture.

methods.name: irq_target_state_set
methods.description: Sets the security target state (Secure/Non-Secure) for an IRQ.

methods.name: irq_target_state_is_secure
methods.description: Checks if an IRQ targets the Secure state.

methods.name: irq_target_state_set_all_non_secure
methods.description: Disables all IRQs and sets their target state to Non-Secure.

methods.name: arch_irq_connect_dynamic
methods.description: Connects a dynamic IRQ with a routine and priority.

methods.name: z_arm_irq_dynamic_direct_isr_dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches the current IRQ in a direct manner.
